purpose: 对实验 2 的技能组合失败做受控归因诊断；本轮不微调模型

tasks.A0: pick up the orange block and place it in the target area, keeping its long side aligned with Y
tasks.A90: pick up the orange block and place it in the target area, with its long side aligned with X
tasks.B: push the orange block along the positive X direction to the wall
tasks.C: pick up the orange block and place it into the tray, with its long side aligned with Y

success_criteria.A0: distance to PLACE <= 2 cm, long axis Y error <= 12 deg, tilt <= 12 deg, released, rest
success_criteria.A90: distance to PLACE <= 2 cm, long axis X error <= 12 deg, tilt <= 12 deg, released, rest
success_criteria.B: front gap to wall <= 2 cm, |lateral dy| <= 2 cm, yaw change <= 15 deg, tilt <= 12 deg, rest
success_criteria.C: |dx| <= 2 cm, |dy| <= 5 cm, long axis Y error <= 12 deg, tilt <= 12 deg, released, rest
